title: Adobe security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-101.031618: TT-CSIRT Advisory – Adobe Security Updates
leadParagraph: Adobe has released a security update stating that a vulnerability has been discovered in Adobe Dreamweaver where an OS Command Injection could be inserted into the URI Handler of the application.
contentHtml:
Adobe has released a security update stating that a vulnerability has been discovered in Adobe Dreamweaver where an OS Command Injection could be inserted into the URI Handler of the application.

This could allow the attacker to perform arbitrary remote code execution.

Further information on this vulnerability and how it can be fixed can be found on Adobe Website at https://helpx.adobe.com/security/products/dreamweaver/apsb18-07.html
